timeline.summary: Welspun Living Limited rescheduled its 4QFY26 Investors & Analysts Conference Call to May 15, 2026, at 14:30 IST with Ms. Dipali Goenka, Mr. Manish Bansal, and Ms. Bharti Agarwal participating.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,435.43 Cr (-8.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹103.7 Cr (-21.3% YoY).
Welspun Living's board approved a share buyback of up to ₹252 Crore at ₹175 per share.
Welspun Living paid a regulatory fine of ₹2.22 lakh in abeyance to BSE pending review of its waiver application regarding Stakeholders Relationship Committee composition.
Welspun Living issued the letter of offer for its ₹252 Cr share buyback, scheduled to run from May 29 to June 4, 2026.
Welspun Living Limited invites investors and analysts to a conference call on Friday, 30 October 2026 at 5:00 PM IST.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,838.12 Cr (+16.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹169.1 Cr (+1202.8% YoY).
Welspun Living reported Q2FY27 revenue growth of 17% YoY to ₹2,870 Cr and achieved a net-cash position.
Welspun Living filed the Q2 FY27 earnings conference call recording link on October 30, 2026.
